y-m-04-02.title: 4 a kowane faranti cikin faranti 3, 3 a kowane faranti cikin faranti 4
y-m-04-02.topic: Ma'anar ninkawa (adadin cikin kundi ɗaya da adadin kundin)
y-m-04-02.goal: Ka yi amfani da jerin ɗigogi wajen fahimtar dalilin da ya sa 3×4 da 4×3 suke da daraja iri ɗaya, sannan ka bambanta cewa ko da darajarsu ɗaya ce, 'labarin' (yawan kundin da adadin cikin kundi ɗaya) ba ɗaya ba ne.
y-m-04-02.material: Karanta ninkawa 3×4 da ma'anar 'kundin 4 na guda 3', 4×3 kuma 'kundin 3 na guda 4'. (Ana karanta 3×4 'uku ninki huɗu', 4×3 kuma 'huɗu ninki uku'.) Kowane faranti yana da adadin tuffa iri ɗaya, babu tuffa da ta rage ko ta ɓace. Doyun ya ce, 'An haɗa faranti 4 na guda 3 da faranti 3 na guda 4 dabam, saboda haka adadin tuffa ma zai bambanta.'
y-m-04-02.thinking.0: Dakatar da yanke hukunci kafin bincike
y-m-04-02.thinking.1: Daidaita hukunci da tabbacin ka da sabon bayani
y-m-04-02.thinking.2: Bambanta abin da ya yi daidai da abin da ya bambanta
y-m-04-02.prereq.0: Ƙirga cikin kundi-kundi masu adadi iri ɗaya (matakin aji na 2)
y-m-04-02.prereq.1: Wani ɓangare na jadawalin ninkin 3 da 4
y-m-04-02.s.s1.prompt: Ka yi nazarin maganar Doyun a matakai ta duba bayanai ɗaya bayan ɗaya.
y-m-04-02.s.s1.hint.0: Domin bincika maganar Doyun, ka ƙirga tuffan da kanka ko ka zana su a matsayin ɗigogi.
y-m-04-02.s.s1.hint.1: Ka duba yadda layuka suke sauyawa idan ka kalli ɗigogi iri ɗaya daga wani gefe.
y-m-04-02.s.s1.st.0.info: Doyun bai ƙirga tuffan ba tukuna. A 'faranti 4 na guda 3' da 'faranti 3 na guda 4', adadin faranti da tuffan da ke kowane faranti sun bambanta.
y-m-04-02.s.s1.st.0.ask: Yanzu me kake tunani game da maganar Doyun?
y-m-04-02.s.s1.st.0.after: Ba a ƙirga komai ba tukuna, don haka yana da wuya a ce daidai ne ko ba daidai ba. Mu zana su a matsayin ɗigogi.
y-m-04-02.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Daidai ne. Idan yadda aka haɗa kundi ya bambanta, jimillar ma ta bambanta.
y-m-04-02.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wannan tunani ya yi imani nan take cewa idan yadda aka haɗa kundi ya bambanta, jimillar ma ta bambanta.
y-m-04-02.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Ba za ka iya sani ba tukuna. Dole ne ka ƙirga ko ka zana don bincika.
y-m-04-02.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wannan tunani ya dakatar da hukunci domin babu shaida.
y-m-04-02.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Ba daidai ba ne. Ko da kundin sun bambanta, jimillar adadi kullum iri ɗaya ce.
y-m-04-02.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ƙarshe na iya zama daidai, amma wannan tunani ya faɗi hakan ba tare da bincike ba.
y-m-04-02.s.s1.st.1.info: An jera ɗigogi 12 a layuka uku, ɗigogi 4 a kowane layi. Da aka juya takardar gefe ba tare da ƙara ko cire ko da digo ɗaya ba, sai suka zama layuka huɗu, ɗigogi 3 a kowane layi.
y-m-04-02.s.s1.st.1.ask: Bayan ganin wannan bayani, ta yaya tunaninka game da maganar Doyun ya canza?
y-m-04-02.s.s1.st.1.after: Duka ra'ayin bincika da misali ɗaya sannan a gwada ƙari, da ra'ayin cewa dalilin 'ɗigogi suna nan yadda suke idan an juya' ya shafi sauran lambobi ma, suna da tushe.
y-m-04-02.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Har yanzu adadin tuffa yana kama da ya bambanta.
y-m-04-02.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wannan tunani ya ji kamar adadin ya canza duk da cewa an juya ɗigogin. Ka duba ko ka taɓa ƙara ko cire digo.
y-m-04-02.s.s1.st.1.o.b: A wannan misalin iri ɗaya ne. Ina son ƙarin bincike ko haka yake ga sauran lambobi.
y-m-04-02.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Wannan tunani ya tabbatar da daidaito a misali ɗaya kuma yana son duba sauran yanayi dabam.
y-m-04-02.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Ana iya juya ɗigogin kawai, saboda haka za a iya cewa adadin iri ɗaya ne a ninkar wasu lambobi ma.
y-m-04-02.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wannan tunani ya gane cewa dalilin 'adadin ɗigogi ba ya canzawa idan an juya' yana aiki ga sauran lambobi ma.
y-m-04-02.s.s1.st.2.info: Tuffan misalan biyun iri ɗaya ne, 12. Doyun ya sake cewa, 'Adadin tuffa iri ɗaya ne, saboda haka labaran biyun daidai suke.'
y-m-04-02.s.s1.st.2.ask: Me ya yi daidai, me kuma ya bambanta?
y-m-04-02.s.s1.st.2.after: Adadin tuffa iri ɗaya ne, 12, amma faranti 3 da 4, da tuffa 4 a faranti da tuffa 3 a faranti sun bambanta. Ko da darajarsu ɗaya ce, labaran ba iri ɗaya ba ne.
y-m-04-02.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Adadin tuffa da adadin faranti duk daidai suke.
y-m-04-02.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Wannan tunani ya ɗauka gabaɗaya cewa komai iri ɗaya ne domin adadin tuffa iri ɗaya ne. Ka kwatanta adadin faranti na farko.
y-m-04-02.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Adadin tuffa da adadin faranti duk sun bambanta.
y-m-04-02.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wannan tunani ya koma ga tsammanin farko. Mun bincika da jerin ɗigogi ko adadin tuffa iri ɗaya ne.
y-m-04-02.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Adadin tuffa iri ɗaya ne, adadin faranti kuma ya bambanta.
y-m-04-02.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wannan tunani ya ware abin da ya yi daidai da wanda ya bambanta.
y-m-04-02.s.s1.reflect: Da farko ka iya dakatar da hukunci domin ba ka bincika ba tukuna. Da ka juya ɗigogin, ka sami shaidar cewa 'adadin iri ɗaya ne'; da ka koma ga labarin faranti, iyakar abin da za ka ce 'iri ɗaya' (adadin kawai ya yi daidai) ta canza. Ka faɗi wane bayani ya sauya wane hukunci.
y-m-04-02.s.s2.prompt: Mina ta bayyana ninkawa biyun. Zaɓi layin da labarinsa bai dace ba.
y-m-04-02.s.s2.hint.0: Ka bambanta ko kowane layi yana magana ne game da 'daraja' ko 'labari'.
y-m-04-02.s.s2.hint.1: Nemo ko akwai bambanci tsakanin faranti 3 masu guda 4 a kowane ɗaya da faranti 4 masu guda 3 a kowane ɗaya.
y-m-04-02.s.s2.line.0: 4×3 kundin 3 ne na guda 4, saboda haka 4, 8, 12, jimilla 12.
y-m-04-02.s.s2.line.1: 3×4 kundin 4 ne na guda 3, saboda haka 3, 6, 9, 12, jimilla 12.
y-m-04-02.s.s2.line.2: Darajarsu iri ɗaya ce, saboda haka labarin 4×3 da 3×4 ma daidai yake.
y-m-04-02.s.s2.line.3: Saboda haka adadin tuffa iri ɗaya ne idan aka sa tuffa 4 a kowane faranti cikin faranti 3 ko tuffa 3 a kowane faranti cikin faranti 4.
y-m-04-02.s.s2.explain: Layi na 3 ba daidai ba ne. Ko da darajarsu iri ɗaya ce, adadin faranti da adadin tuffa a kowane faranti sun bambanta, saboda haka labaran ba iri ɗaya ba ne. Layuka 1, 2, da 4 daidai ne.
y-m-04-02.s.s3.prompt: Ka gaya wa Doyun a jimloli ɗaya ko biyu. Ka rubuta abin da ya yi daidai da wanda ya bambanta a yanayin biyun.
y-m-04-02.s.s3.hint.0: Da farko rubuta adadin tuffa gaba ɗaya, sannan ka kwatanta adadin faranti da tuffan da ke kan faranti ɗaya.
y-m-04-02.s.s3.hint.1: Ka rubuta dabam abin da 'iri ɗaya' da 'dabam' suke magana a kai.
y-m-04-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka bayyana a fili, da lambobi ko kalmomi, abin da ya yi daidai?
y-m-04-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka faɗi abin da ya bambanta ta ambaton faranti ko kundi?
y-m-04-02.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka guji cewa maganar Doyun daidai ce kawai ko ba daidai ba ce kawai?
y-m-04-02.s.s3.model.0: A yanayin biyun akwai tuffa 12, adadi ɗaya. Amma ko faranti 3 ne ko 4, da yawan tuffa a faranti ɗaya sun bambanta.
y-m-04-02.s.s3.model.1: Jimillar tuffa iri ɗaya ce, amma faranti 4 masu guda 3 a kowane ɗaya da faranti 3 masu guda 4 a kowane ɗaya labarai ne mabambanta.
y-m-04-02.s.s3.modelNote.1: Ya faɗi abin da ya bambanta gaba ɗaya da kalmar 'labaran sun bambanta'.

y-m-04-04.topic: Nemo tsarin da ke cikin jadawalin lambobi
y-m-04-04.goal: Rarrabe tsarin da za a iya bayyana ta hanyoyi daban-daban daga akwatuna masu launi iri ɗaya; koyi cewa tsarin yana dogara da siffar jadawali (adadin akwatuna a kowane layi), sannan ka sake gano tsarin a sabon jadawali.

y-m-04-04.s.s2.o.b: Idan ka canza jadawali, lambobin masu launi ba su da wani tsari kwata-kwata

y-m-04-04.s.s2.o.c: Tsarin ƙaruwa da 5 yana daidai ne kawai a jadawalin da ke da 5 a kowane layi
y-m-04-04.s.s2.r.c: Wannan tunani ya ga cewa tsarin ya danganta da siffar jadawali.
